pattern: board agent resolves review comments and reports status
experience: A lane-rule agent gets review feedback queued from the board. It must fix each comment, resolve it with t3_board, and report its status, or the ticket keeps showing unresolved feedback.

source.origin: Authored guard for the Kanban board feature (t3_board, lane pickups, queued review feedback). Not a captured transcript.

board.instructions: Implement the ticket, run the tests, then set your status to needs_review.

ticket.title: Rename the user fetcher
ticket.description:
`fetchAll` in `src/users.ts` only fetches users. Rename it so callers can tell.

- [ ] Rename the function
- [ ] Update its test

comments.body: The test still imports the old name.

priorTurns.text: Renamed `fetchAll` to `fetchAllUsers`, tests pass, and the ticket is ready for review.

input.command: sed -i 's/fetchAll =/fetchAllUsers =/' src/users.ts && pnpm vitest run src/users.test.ts

notes: The pickup prompt and review feedback come from apps/server/src/board/boardPrompts.ts via setup.board. Without t3_board, or without the resolve and status lines in those texts, the agent has no way to clear the feedback.
